title: Pay the fire service contribution on insurance premiums
what: Pay the State Fire Commission each month the prescribed percentage of premium income from the prescribed classes of insurance.

sources.title: Fire Service Act 1979 (Tas)
sources.quote: insurance company must, not later than 14 days after the end of each month, pay to the Commission an amount equal to the prescribed percentage of the total premium income payable to that insurance company in respect of the prescribed classes of insurance during that month
